post.summary: Generate the TL 407 (the assigned consultant) for the readiness checked: its source token, every warning confirmed by code (each audited warning_confirmed); stored encrypted as a document with its provenance (form_generated)
post.description:
Refusals:
- `409 source_changed` at `/sourceToken`: a source moved since the readiness (also when found at the record); check again.
- `422` with a warning code at `/confirmWarnings`: that warning isn't confirmed.
- `422` with form-level error codes (pointer empty: `form_version_unavailable`, `required_missing`, `character_unsupported`, …; each code once): the form can't be generated. The readiness names the fields.
- `422 participation_closed`; `503 pdf_unavailable` (the Anlage can't be rendered) or `storage_unavailable`.

201.description: Generated: the document, its version and whether an Anlage was appended

post.summary: Generate the Kug 200b (the PL or the assigned consultant; ta_tg): 1–12 filled, 13–19 and the declarations left for the participant's hand; stored encrypted with its handwriting checklist (blank * fields, text that doesn't fit), audited form_generated; the values it prints from the sensitive answers each read audited
post.description:
Refusals:
- `422` with form-level error codes (`form_version_unavailable`, `character_unsupported`, `identifier_too_long`, …), `participation_closed`, `asu_not_applicable` (a `ta_only` project); in a bulk at `/participationIds/<index>`.
- `409 source_changed`: a source moved between the read and the record; generate again.
- `503 storage_unavailable`.

201.description: Generated: the document(s), the version and the handwriting checklist

post.summary: Issue an export (kug200b_print: one print file of 1–100 generated Kug 200b forms of one project the viewer may open; kug200b_batch_index: an open Kug 200b batch's work list, its PL only), audited export_created; a same-origin link bound to this staff session, valid 60 s; no file is stored
post.description:
Refusals:
- `404` for a form that doesn't exist, is deleted, isn't a generated Kug 200b or isn't the viewer's to open, and for a batch the viewer doesn't lead, whatever its state.
- `403` in assisted mode.
- Only for forms the viewer sees: `422 document_quarantined`, `422 document_invalidated`; `422 invalid_argument` for forms of more than one project or a body of another kind.
- Only for a batch the viewer leads: `422 batch_not_open`; `422 batch_stale` with `staleRows`.

get.summary: The export of a link as an attachment (no-store, nosniff, the download policy): only with the staff session that asked and within 60 s, else 404; every form or batch member re-authorized now (422 export_stale when one is no longer the viewer's, deleted or quarantined, or a member moved); rendered at the download, stored nowhere, audited export_downloaded

post.summary: Build a Kug 200b batch (the PL) of one placement Agentur's accepted scans, 1–200, all or nothing, its membership fixed: refused without the Agentur's batch channel (batch_settings_missing) and with the rows of every scan that can't join (batch_stale)

"Übermittelt am" for an open batch (its PL): the actual sent date from the batch's day to today, after the recheck (batch_stale with the rows, nothing written); records each member's submission and, on the route kug_200b, its ASU registration on that date
Discard an open batch (its PL): its members are free for a new batch; the batch stays as history
